summary: This round fixes all three round-3 findings. F6: `ExtensionHost.delete` now bounds its control-plane lookup with `AbortSignal.timeout(5000)`, the same limit as `loadRemoteLinks`. F7: `retireLocalCopies` now skips retirement while a saved removal for the same app exists, and a temp test confirms that a template-copy restore survives a reload and a restart. F8: new temp tests cover the VM-side guards, the receipt and restore failures, invalid or cyclic install IDs, and the delete refusals; a durable test covers the unreachable VM. All test runs pass, the coverage gate passes, and no defects remain.
